name: create-spreadsheet
description: Creates a Google Sheets spreadsheet with a title, optional named tabs, and an optional header row on each named tab. Returns the spreadsheet id used as `spreadsheet` by other google-sheets tools, its URL, and tab titles.

tabs.description: Optional tab names. If omitted or empty, Google creates one default tab.

header.description: Optional header cells to write as row 1 of every named tab.
